name: Floofybutt
source:
This pompous patriarch can seem a little grumpy at first.
Likes treasures and collectibles, war strategies, red meat.
Dislikes insubordination, trespassers, and outsiders, people calling him Floofybutt.
Age: 10 years, 4 months 
Breed: Red Tabby Persian 

Can you help him open up and show you his heart of gold?
